purpose: Independent practice of F1.1 dollar coins.
student_learning_goal: I can identify the loonie and toonie.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can identify the loonie and toonie.
header.character_watermark: Penny the Penguin Shopkeeper in the top-right with apron. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Circle the LOONIE and the TOONIE among 6 coins.
parts.visual_layout: Six coin icons in a row with circles to mark the loonie and toonie.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 find-the-coin layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 6 coin icons: nickel, dime, quarter, 50¢, loonie, toonie. Each circleable.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_FIND at Part 1: keywords name the coins circle find task.

parts.student_instructions: Match each of 6 coins to its value.
parts.visual_layout: Six coins on the left and six values on the right.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 coin-value match for money worksheet, B&W line art. Left: 6 coins. Right: 5¢, 10¢, 25¢, 50¢, $1, $2.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_VALUES at Part 2: keywords name the coins values match task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw how many LOONIES make 1 TOONIE.
parts.visual_layout: An empty workspace with a toonie picture and labelled blanks for the equivalent loonies.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 equivalence workspace for money worksheet, B&W line art. Left: 1 toonie. Right: empty space for loonies. Below: '___ loonies = 1 toonie.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_LOONIES at Part 3: keywords name the toonie loonies equivalence task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a loonie or toonie at home and tell its picture.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Formative — check loonie/toonie identification.
